title: Haye alamdaar, haye alamdaar
body:
Haye alamdaar, haye alamdaar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Karte hai matam haram abbas ka
hogaya marna sitam abbas ka..(4)
<<MINI>>
Haye alamdaar, haye alamdaar..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehte the kamar thaam ke ye sayyede abraar
<<MINI>>
Haye alamdaar, haye alamdaar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ye haal hai laashe ka sambhala nahi jaata..(2)
teer aankh se bhai ki nikala nahi jaata
Imdaad ko aajaiye ya haider e qarrar
<<MINI>>
Haye alamdaar, haye alamdaar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Zainab ne teri aas pe chhoda tha madina
mai kaise batau use saqqaye sakina
mara gaya zainab teri chadar ka nigehdaar
<<MINI>>
Haye alamdaar, haye alamdaar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tum qatl hue hum pe bhi chal jayegi shamsheer
aghyaar mein reh jaegi tanha meri hamsheer
zainab ki rida bachne ke baaqi nahi aasaar
<<MINI>>
Haye alamdaar, haye alamdaar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jis tarha se ghar laye the masjid se Ali ko
us tarha se le jayenge khaime mein jari ko
akbar mere bhai ka janaza karo tayyar
<<MINI>>
Haye alamdaar, haye alamdaar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Bazu bhi qalam hogaye ae bazu e shabbir
tukde hai badan aankh mein paywast hua teer
kisne ye meri maa ki duao'n pe kiya waar
<<MINI>>
Haye alamdaar, haye alamdaar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aati hai sada loot lo namoos e nabi ko
ab maarna aasa'n hai Hussain ibn e ali ko
marne pe tere jashn manate hai sitamgaar
<<MINI>>
Haye alamdaar, haye alamdaar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Akbar hume mushkil se bohot laaye hai bhai
maidaan mein girte hue hum aaye hai bhai
aakhein to zara kholo mere munis o ghumkhwaar
<<MINI>>
Haye alamdaar, haye alamdaar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Ek baat tumhein karb ki batlata hu bhaiyya
jab bhi koi masuma ke marega tamacha
ro ro ke pukaregi sakina tumhe har baar
<<MINI>>
Haye alamdaar, haye alamdaar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Tha mir takallum yehi shabbir ka nauha
jaate hue pura karo armaan hamara
aye bhai hume bhai pukaro zara ek baar
<<MINI>>
